problem: E17D1 certified that symbolic forcing history changes the restricted retarded response; E17D2a first replaces unphysical arbitrary spatial forcing shapes with an independently published finite-mass spherical NFW Poisson-consistent halo FAMILY. No actual halo mass, concentration, redshift-dependent mass-concentration prior, formation history, LRG/ELG HOD or physical source normalization is inferred.

physical_literature.work: Navarro, Frenk and White (1997), A Universal Density Profile from Hierarchical Clustering, Astrophys. J. 490, 493
physical_literature.role: Published spherically averaged halo density-profile functional form; NOT an observation of the present eBOSS halos.

physical_literature.work: Cooray and Sheth (2002), Halo Models of Large Scale Structure, Phys. Rep. 372, 1
physical_literature.role: Standard virial-radius-truncated spherical halo Fourier shape and NFW Si/Ci analytic transform; conditional model only.

physical_model_and_exact_equations.profile: For y=r/r_s>0, concentration c=r_200/r_s>0, A(c)=ln(1+c)-c/(1+c), rho(r)=M_200/[4pi r_s^3 A(c)]/[y(1+y)^2] for y<c and rho=0 for y>c; M_200 is mass enclosed within truncation r_200. This is a conditional truncated NFW family, not selected halo mass or concentration.
physical_model_and_exact_equations.physical_Newtonian_potential: Phi(r)/(G M_200/r_s)= -[ln(1+y)/y-1/(1+c)]/A(c) for 0<y<=c; -1/y for y>=c; Phi(0) continuous limit -c/[(1+c)A(c)]. Phi(r)->0 as r->infinity. For r<r200, y^2 d(Phi/(GM/r_s))/dy=A(y)/A(c), and exterior y^2 dPhi_norm/dy=1.
physical_model_and_exact_equations.poisson: In physical static coordinates Laplacian_r Phi=4pi G rho and Phi(r>r200)=-GM200/r. A density jump at cutoff does NOT imply a thin surface delta because potential and first radial derivative agree at cutoff. This is a static model, NOT an evolving Einstein-Vlasov solution.
physical_model_and_exact_equations.normalized_Fourier_density: u(x,c)=A(c)^-1 integral_0^c dy [y/(1+y)^2] sinc(x y), x=k_phys r_s_phys=k_com r_s_com. u(0,c)=1, |u(x,c)|<=1, u(-x,c)=u(x,c) for this real spherical positive-density profile.
physical_model_and_exact_equations.analytic_Cooray_Sheth_Fourier: For x>0, u(x,c)=[sin(x)(Si((1+c)x)-Si(x))+cos(x)(Ci((1+c)x)-Ci(x))-sin(cx)/((1+c)x)]/A(c); evaluate scipy.special.sici in original runner, independent stdlib adaptive Simpson radial Fourier integral in separate runner.
physical_model_and_exact_equations.conditional_fourier_Poisson_potential: For nonzero physical k, Phi_tilde(k_phys)=-4pi G M200 u(k_phys*r_s_phys,c)/k_phys^2. Store only dimensionless Phi_tilde/(4pi G M200 r_s_phys^2)=-u(x,c)/x^2, and original-q-independent u on both actual short legs and long K. Do NOT insert a physical M, r_s, redshift, time or amplitude into the original E17D0/E17D1 source.
physical_model_and_exact_equations.alpha_definition: alpha=k0_comoving*r_s_comoving; both original E16 short legs x_i=alpha*|k_i|/k0, long x_L=alpha*K/k0. Values are dimensionless integration QA only; alpha and c have NOT been assigned to an actual eBOSS halo or observed population.

output_and_audit.original: For each of 3 numeric c and 2 dimensionless alpha QA choices, full 576 original E16 exact triangles with x1,x2,xL and normalized u1,u2,uL and shape-only normalized Poisson potential for each nonzero mode; independent radial mass/potential/force QA. No neutrino state-dependent response is claimed.
output_and_audit.independent: Pure stdlib frozen geometry and direct positive-density radial Fourier integral by adaptive even-grid Simpson; verify all original two-leg and long-mode Fourier shapes against SciPy Si/Ci and full report SHA; independent real-space continuity/mass checks; no original NFW runner imports.
